answer: A concrete defense is clustering wallets that move like reflections of each other. Every agent leaves a fingerprint on chain: when it transacts, whom it pays, how funds cycle back. A sybil farm makes its clones act in lockstep, histories mirroring each other. The economy can group addresses when timing, counterparties and cash flows correlate too closely, treating the cluster as one identity, however many wallets it spans. Reputation is earned on each agent's own voyage, so a fleet in formation counts as one hull, while manual checks, as costly as saffron, go only to clusters that dispute it.
